articles.title: President Prabowo refuses to sell state defense industries
articles.summary: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto revealed he blocked past attempts to sell strategic domestic defense industries. He stressed a strong local defense sector is crucial for national sovereignty, economic independence, and job creation. Subianto is committed to bolstering Indonesia's defense capabilities by prioritizing domestic production, reducing foreign reliance, and resisting calls to import over local manufacturing.

articles.title: Navy Ranks: A Complete Guide to Enlisted and Officer Ranks
articles.summary: Enlisted sailors are foundational to the U.S. Navy, performing vital daily tasks essential for maintaining fleet mission readiness. They undergo training in a wide array of specialties, such as engineering, enabling them to execute critical operations. This emphasis on skilled personnel underscores the importance of human capital in ensuring naval effectiveness and operational preparedness for national defence.

articles.title: isodistrreg added to PyPI
articles.summary: This article details Python bindings for Isotonic Distributional Regression (IDR) and Survival-IDR (S-IDR). Built with PyO3 and maturin, these tools empower advanced statistical modeling and data analysis, particularly for predictive analytics, forecasting, and survival analysis. This development highlights ongoing advancements in scientific computing and open-source software, making complex analytical techniques more accessible for various applications.
